metadata.title: On the singular set of the geodesic flow on nonpositively curved surfaces
metadata.abstract: We prove that the singular locus of the geodesic flow on the unit tangent bundle of a nonpositively curved surface enjoys an additional regularity property: its characteristic function belongs to the geometric anisotropic Sobolev space $H^{5/8-}_xH^{-13/16}_\theta$. In particular, this implies that if the geodesic flow is not ergodic with respect to the Liouville measure, then the zero set of the curvature must be thick in the sense that it supports a nonzero, nonnegative function in $H^{5/8-}$. The proof relies on semiclassical analysis and a new radial estimate for parabolic flows.

analysis.progressType: 非正曲率测地流奇异集正则性
analysis.workSummary: 证明非正曲率曲面单位切丛上测地流奇异集的特征函数属于几何各向异性 Sobolev 空间 Hₓ^(5/8−)Hθ^(−13/16)。因此若 Liouville 测度下不遍历，曲率零集必须支撑非零非负 H^(5/8−) 函数。
techniques: 各向异性 Sobolev 正则性
analysis.breakthrough: 把测地流非遍历性转化为曲率零集具有定量厚度的必要条件。
analysis.limitations: 仅给出非遍历时零集厚度的必要条件，不能反推任意厚零集必然导致非遍历。
analysis.priorityReason: 曲率退化集与测地流遍历性的定量桥梁。
